The "Choose Pro" button on the highlighted plan is now green, using the same `--color-success` token (`#1a7f37`) as the success messages. The text stays white. The functional tests pass (16/16). I didn't check the page in a browser.

I added the rule in `site/css/pages.css`, scoped to `.plan-featured .btn-primary`, so other primary buttons keep the brand teal. I also gave it a darker green hover state, which you didn't ask for. It's the success green mixed 20% toward black, so the button still reacts on hover instead of falling back to teal.

STATUS: DONE
